title: AT 4K THE HUD STACK DOES NOT OVERLAP
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-06, at the sizes he plays (4K): the weapon panel grows with its corner and was painted over the HIDDEN / CONCEALED chip, and the boss bar sat inside the clock and compass stack, its name under the extract arrow at 1080p and printed over the compass at 1440p and 4K; the offer line sat on the message toast. The chip now sits above the panel at every size and is a HUD panel, and the boss bar and the offer line sit below the top stack, scaled with it.
now: At 1440p and 4K the HIDDEN chip, the boss bar and the clock no longer print over each other.

edits.replacement: w=Math.min(520,W*0.4); x=W/2-w/2; y=Math.round(LH(108)*hudRes());   // v16.xx: below the clock, the compass and the extract arrow, scaled with them (was LH(64), inside the stack)
y=Math.round(LH(132)*hudRes());   // v16.xx: below the boss bar and above the message plate (was LH(104), on the toast)
